name: Carvera Air — nominal envelopes from Makera simplified CAD
notes: Extracted from Z component of official simplified STEP on 2026-11-11. Cylinders are exact CAD radii; motor and Z plate use conservative bounding boxes. This is not metrology-grade CAD. Confirm actual nose, collar, accessories, stickout, orientation and operating offsets before setting verified=true. Does not model the X gantry, probe, dust shoe, hoses, wiring or machine frame.
coordinate_derivation: CAD local spindle center x=-74.0385852576533, z=28.999999999998; lower nose y=201.458967162417. Simulator X=CAD x+74.0385852576533, Y=29-CAD z, Z=CAD y-201.458967162417. Gauge is lower nose face, tip+stickout.

provenance.controller_notes: This nominal Carvera Air profile does not define a G28 clearance path; supply measured clearance_moves. Its controller documentation describes G28 as clearance positioning and warns about inch-mode compatibility. No generic homing path is inferred.
provenance.compatibility_notes: This is not a Carvera C1 profile and is not a universal machine model.
